import math

# Rural Electrification Administration values (in millions $) for fiscal years 1961-1970
# From Table FD-10 in treasury_bulletin_1970_10_page_35.txt
rea_values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

print("REA Values (millions $):", rea_values)
print("Number of years:", len(rea_values))

n = len(rea_values)
mean = sum(rea_values) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Theil index: T = (1/n) * Σ((x_i/mean) * log(x_i/mean))
theil_sum = 0
for x in rea_values:
    ratio = x / mean
    term = ratio * math.log(ratio)
    theil_sum += term
    print(f"  x={x}, ratio={ratio:.6f}, term={term:.6f}")

theil = theil_sum / n
print(f"\nTheil Index (unrounded): {theil}")
print(f"Theil Index (rounded to thousandths): {round(theil, 3)}")

# Write to answer file
with open("/app/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"{round(theil, 3)}")
print("\nWritten to /app/answer.txt")
EOF
